verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-053 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-053: a rejected audit record of a significant mutation carries result=rejected and a closed reason_code
verdicts.why: The check verifies one rejected audit row has result "rejected" and a specific closed reason code, and verifies reason codes for additional rejections. It does not verify that those additional audit rows also have result "rejected".

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-020 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-020: an accepted ApprovedEstimateSnapshot is immutable; versions are append-only and never overwritten or deleted
verdicts.why: The check detects attempts to insert snapshots with duplicate identifiers or identity and verifies the stored count remains unchanged. It does not attempt or detect mutation or deletion of an already accepted snapshot.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-052 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-052: audit records and import records are append-only; no flow mutates or deletes them
verdicts.why: The check verifies duplicate import-record insertion is refused and exercises flows that append import and audit rows. It does not test update or deletion attempts against either import records or audit records.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: recorded reason equals exception reason [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements:
A snapshot import rejection's recorded reason equals the raised exception's
  `reason`, whatever its message text.
verdicts.why: The check verifies fixed mappings from three catalog exception types to expected returned and recorded reason codes. It does not compare a raised exception's own `reason` value with the recorded reason or vary message text to establish message independence.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-021 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-021: re-publication with identical (project, estimate_id, estimate_version) and identical fingerprint is an idempotent replay; a different fingerprint for the same identity is an integrity conflict storing nothing
verdicts.why: The identical publication is asserted to be an idempotent replay reusing the snapshot, while a content-changing publication under the same identity is asserted to be an integrity conflict with no new snapshot stored.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-037 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-037: all monetary values are EUR with decimal 2-digit semantics and ROUND_HALF_UP; foreign currency input is rejected explicitly, never converted
verdicts.why: The check explicitly verifies that foreign currency input is rejected with the currency-mismatch reason. It does not assert two-decimal monetary semantics, ROUND_HALF_UP behavior, or directly verify that conversion never occurs.
